Place your site icons in this folder.

Minimum:
- favicon.ico   (16–32 px, ICO format). This is referenced by index.html as /favicon.ico

Optional (for crisper icons on modern browsers):
- favicon.svg   (vector; referenced as a secondary <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml">)
- apple-touch-icon.png (180x180)
- favicon-32x32.png / favicon-16x16.png

How to use:
1) Replace this folder’s files with your own icons.
2) Keep the name favicon.ico exactly; Vite will serve it at /favicon.ico.
